Location

Know where you are and start directions.

Personal dataRuns on: Your phoneOff until you add it

Why you will want it

Ask where you are right now, or name a place and Ultron starts navigation in your maps app. Your location is shared only when you ask.

Every tool in this connector

Tells you where you are and starts directions in your maps app. Ultron picks the right tool from what you say, so you never have to name one.

  • Current location

    Tell where the phone is right now.

    Try sayingMain abhi kahan hu?

  • Directions

    Start navigation to a place.

    Try sayingRailway station ka rasta shuru karo.

Access and privacy

Needs
Location access.
Runs on
Your phone
Privacy
Your location is shared when you ask where you are.
Default
Off. You turn it on from the Connectors page in the app.

Reads private data from your phone, such as contacts, calendar, location, files and notifications. What you ask about is sent to Gemini.
